TC-13/S27.title: Two Hospital patients: a photo on one, a paste on the other, switching patient while 'Reading' or 'Extracting'
TC-13/S27.detail: New spec pn-tc13-s27-switch.spec.ts, socket-delayed answers so each switch is inside the pending call: B never shows or stores A's read/extraction; A never gets B's; each chart has only its own note and imaging; no vitals stored. Recorded (not specified): leaving A while 'Reading…' loses the read text, the photo had to be taken again.
